validation.localDatabaseIntegration: Passed against an existing local stack with deterministic model responses; verified atomic request persistence, hidden public evidence, second-visit delivery, same-screen idempotency and late-request delivery on the third visit. Test session removed.
validation.visualQA: Five PDF pages rendered and inspected; desktop duty-log exhibit inspected; three other exhibits inspected at 390px mobile width with no horizontal overflow; PDF text and page count checked.

limitations: The 22 checks comprise 20 classifier/control checks and 2 deterministic recall-boundary checks, across two repetitions. They are not 22 new suspect conversations.
The local integration test mocks model responses; live provider classification is evaluated separately.
Existing recorded persona dialogues and six-exhibit confession gate were not regenerated in this timing revision.
A report is queued only when a recognized request receives a system acknowledgment. Invalid or ungrounded classifier output cannot queue a report.
Previously unlocked reports in existing saved sessions remain available.
developmentFindings: Initial use of host arrival judgment rejected valid work orders; requests now have a separate classifier.

An intermediate classifier mistook allegations and candidate definitions for requests; action-word screening, separate message placement and grounded source quotations addressed this. The final repeated run passed all listed checks.

requestOnlyFollowup.change: Each report remains separate. Removed generic host-help ordering and defensive host-judgment ordering of deferred reports; only a specific investigator request can queue them. Delivery remains the next Devraj interview visit.

verification.localDatabaseIntegration: Passed: generic help exposes no deferred report; direct fallback attempts rejected; requesting phone location reveals only that report at recall; unrequested call and duty-log reports remain hidden after later recalls.
